findings.claim: The G-STEM major on q2 (blind pick = the key) ships unretired: the pedagogy pass edited only the rationale and the meta, never the option text, and the unit's own hedge_balance / law11_check sections do not acknowledge the form lean.
findings.evidence: verdicts.jsonl line 95, G-STEM q:2, severity major: "PARTIALLY (blind pick D): C falls from form as an off-topic superlative ('det största problemet i skolan') ... B is a policy prescription rather than a statement the text could be said to match. A overreaches ... D is then the measured thesis that fits the study design." diff candidates-corrected -> candidates-final touches exactly two lines: the q2 rationale ("slutstyckets slutsats" -> "slutsatsen i stycke 4"; "en textuppgift" -> "en uppgift i texten") and generator_meta.hedge_balance. All eight option strings and both stems are byte-identical across candidates / candidates-corrected / candidates-final. Independent blind reproduction (options only, passage hidden): A ties itself to a named study whose design is unknown to a passage-blind solver, B is the only prescription under a stem that asks which statement matches a text, C is the only superlative about "skolan" rather than about läxan, and D is the only bare mechanism claim — I land on D without the passage, as the gate did.
findings.why: The pedagogy skill's own remit is whether a test-wise student can score without reading. The recorded MINOR_FIXES verdict is defensible on outcome (the gate itself rates this 'a lean, not a form-alone leak', and report.json books the unit as SURVIVED_FLAGGED), but the stage neither repaired the asymmetry nor recorded a dissent, so a major-severity psychometric flag ships with no disposition attached to it.

findings.claim: The key is the longest option in both questions by character count — the length tell the pedagogy probe asks to check across a unit.
findings.evidence: Q1 (key B): A 69, B 87, C 74, D 67 chars. Q2 (key D): A 91, B 101, C 88, D 103 chars. Mitigation, verified: the effect does not survive in word counts — Q1 A 9, B(key) 10, C 11, D 10; Q2 A 13, B 16, C 13, D(key) 15, i.e. the key is NOT the longest in words in either question — and the q2 char margin is 2 characters (103 vs 101), which is noise.
findings.why: Real and checkable, but weak: n=2, contradicted by word counts, and q1's 13-char gap is carried by the key legitimately restating the passage's own phrase "skillnaderna mellan eleverna". Documentation-grade rather than verdict-changing.

findings.claim: "sju av skolorna" is a definite plural with no antecedent and no denominator anywhere in the unit; the reader cannot tell whether seven schools is most of them or a minority, which is exactly what the sentence's rhetorical point turns on.
findings.evidence: Passage introduces only classes, never schools: "följde under läsåret 2022/23 arton klasser i årskurs sex". Paragraph 3 then writes "Kommunal läxhjälp fanns vid sju av skolorna, men söktes framför allt av elever vars vuxna redan visste att den fanns." No school count appears in the passage, the stems, the options, the rationales or generator_meta (grep for 'skolor' in candidates-final/las-b12-003.json returns only this sentence plus q2 option B's 'grundskolan' and option C's 'skolan').
findings.why: Bridging definites are ordinary in journalism, and no question depends on the number, so this is not student-harmful. It is nonetheless the 'a number that won't reconcile' probe firing on a real span, and the integrated MINOR_NOTES verdict carries no visible note about it.

findings.claim: The q1 options compress a three-term ranking into two terms using a compound that never occurs in the passage, and drop the middle term entirely — the one place a complaining student has a foothold.
findings.evidence: Passage: "Skillnaderna mellan eleverna var störst i matematikläxan, mindre i läsläxan och minst i den läxa där eleverna skulle läsa högt för någon." Three named types. Options A and B use "högläsningsläxan", a compound absent from the passage; no option mentions "läsläxan". A student who maps "högläsningsläxan" onto the passage's "läsläxan" (the middle term) would read key B, "Matematikläxan gav de största skillnaderna mellan eleverna, högläsningsläxan de minsta", as false and find no correct option.
findings.why: The mapping högläsning = 'läsa högt' is transparent for a native reader and the key stays uniquely best under the correct reading (both G-KEY votes, in both the pre-final and the verdicts-vfinal re-run, answered B), so this is a difficulty feature rather than a defect. Recorded because it is the unit's sharpest complaint vector and neither expert stage left a note on it.

findings.claim: The q2 rationale's design claim "Inget enskilt stycke räcker för att bära påståendet" is arguable rather than true: paragraph 4 alone supplies both halves of key D.
findings.evidence: Key D: "Läxan flyttar arbetet hem, och därför mäter den hemmets förutsättningar lika mycket som elevens insats." Paragraph 4 alone: "det som ska göras hemma bör vara sådant som går att göra utan lärare" (work is done at home) and "Och så länge uppgiften är obligatorisk och bedöms som om alla hade samma kök att sitta vid, mäter vi inte elevens arbete utan hemmets" (it measures the home, not the pupil). Defence, which is why this is minor: paragraph 4 grounds the measuring claim in the task being obligatorisk and bedömd, whereas D's "därför" makes it follow from the relocation itself, and only paragraph 1 states that — "Läxan är en förflyttning... Det mesta följer av den skillnaden."
findings.why: The claim is about item design, not about the passage's content, and it is defensible on a tight reading of D's causal connective. It does not touch the key, which stays uniquely best; it only means the rationale's synthesis boast is stronger than the text strictly licenses.

refutation_attempts_that_failed.language: Full sweep of passage and all eight options found no calque, agreement, register or spelling-variety defect. The one G-SPRAK finding (3/3 votes, 'Det gör mig obekväm med att kalla en förflyttning för en metod') is genuinely repaired in the shipped file with the exact alternative G-SPRAK-2 proposed: 'Det gör mig tveksam till att kalla en förflyttning för en metod.' 'göra ngn tveksam till att' is idiomatic; no new calque introduced. Checked and cleared: 'Spridningen sade desto mer' (standalone 'desto' after a negated contrast is standard), 'över huvud taget', 'glosor måste nötas', 'elever vars vuxna' (current school-sector usage), predicative agreement in every option ('lika stor' / 'störst' / 'de minsta' / 'ogjord'), gapping comma in q1 B, and numerals spelled out (arton, sju, tio, tjugo) with only 'läsåret 2022/23' in figures. The em dashes (U+2014) are house convention, not a defect: every LÄS passage in every batch uses U+2014 and the authentic las/reference-unit.json contains four of them. English trap tokens inside Swedish rationales are likewise corpus-wide convention (verified across batch10-12).
refutation_attempts_that_failed.pedagogy: Fact-checked every claim in both rationales against the passage. All hold: 'den avslutande meningen i stycke 2' is correct (paragraph 2 does end on the ranking sentence); 'slutsatsen i stycke 4' is correct on a \n\n split (1 Diskussionen / 2 Torbjörn / 3 Elmerud är noga / 4 Jag är ingen läxmotståndare / 5 Det gör mig inte till motståndare / 6 glossary) — note this was WRONG in candidates-corrected ('slutstyckets slutsats'; the actual slutstycke is paragraph 5) and the pedagogy pass fixed it. The same pass fixed a false meta claim: hedge_balance previously read 'Q1 innehåller inga garderingar alls i något alternativ', which is false ('ungefär' in C, 'oftast' in D); candidates-final states the corrected version. Trap labels survive challenge under the blueprint's own definitions (las/blueprint-template.md line 95: reversed_causality = 'flip the arrow / swap subject<->object of the target claim', which covers q1 A's end-for-end swap of the ranking).
refutation_attempts_that_failed.integrated: Every quoted span in every rationale and in generator_meta verified verbatim against current shipped text: 'blev inte gjort alls', 'över huvud taget', 'Jag är ingen läxmotståndare', 'ett verkligt bekymmer', 'ungefär lika stor' (q1 C), 'oftast' (q1 D), 'förhållandevis lite' (q2 A), 'bör avskaffas' and 'systematiskt' (q2 B), 'blev inte gjort' (self_blind_solve). No stale quote survives the candidates-corrected -> candidates-final edit. No self-contradiction between the two rationales. cross_question_check verified true by inspection: no q1 option contains hem/hjälp/ansvar, no q2 option contains a subject name, a duration or the ranking. Law 11 holds — each q2 distractor carries a locatable error (A claims what Elmerud says he did not measure, B demands what the writer disowns in clear text, C promotes a concession the text assigns to the schedule).
refutation_attempts_that_failed.key_sanity: Q1 B and Q2 D are each uniquely best and defensible to a complaining student. Q1: B is a direct paraphrase of the paragraph-2 closer; A is its exact inverse, C asserts the uniformity the text denies, D reports a completion ranking the study never produced. Q2: A is barred by 'Han har inte mätt kunskapsutveckling över huvud taget'; B by 'Jag är ingen läxmotståndare' plus the explicit defence of högläsning and glosor; C by 'men det är schemats bekymmer och inte läxans'. D's 'lika mycket som' is weaker than the text's exclusive 'mäter vi inte elevens arbete utan hemmets', but a weakening cannot be false where the stronger claim holds, and the stem is 'överensstämmer bäst'. Four independent G-KEY votes (two pre-final, two in verdicts-vfinal against the shipped file) answered B and D.
